comparison.objective: Sort three waste items into two hinged bins and close both lids.
comparison.physical_skill: Open articulated lids, classify and deposit items, then close lids, with two-arm coordination demonstrated.
comparison.success_condition: All items enter their rule-specified bins below the rims and both lids close; any wrong-bin entry permanently zeros the episode.
comparison.reason: Tests access sequencing, classification, and bulk containment, not precision tool impact or recovery of newly fractured millimetre-scale pieces.
